premises.text: Despite huge online apparel spend, ~90% of fashion still sells in-store because shoppers cannot judge fit online

premises.text: No special hardware, downloads, webcams, or scanners—works on PC, Mac, or iPad in-browser

premises.text: Scalable designer digitization feeds retailers through an API with pay-as-you-go pricing and analytics dashboards
